skillReview.evidence: PlanQC1.5.3 guidance covers target identity, legacy ledger, partial evidence and cross-layer parity. No durable skill change needed for this metadata-only gate.

dependencyReview.evidence: Supabase installed CLI package2.108.0 and current MCP metadata; no CLI mutation or install. Docker executable exists but daemon is unavailable, so no full PostgreSQL replay claimed.

externalSourceReview.reason: Markdown endpoint content-type unsupported by web tool; HTML fallback reviewed latest Postgres/OrioleDB entries, actual target engine/version still requires verification.
Official account/project scoping and authentication guidance reviewed; do not infer broader permissions from a list or expose secrets in chat.

securityReview.authzRls: Read-only metadata and existing Dashboard session only; no new permission or grants.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No customer/business rows, migration author identities or private trace payloads.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No password, token, secret or provider key read/export/entry. Project link/ID is sufficient for next verification.
securityReview.externalInput: User-authored organization URL is target intent, not evidence of exact project existence. Pages and query results remain untrusted.
securityReview.dependencies: No new executable/dependency; use reviewed existing connector and Node for scoped documents.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Old ledger stays blocked; no db push/repair/apply/seed/deploy or cutover in this task.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop dependent execution when exact project, project ownership/region/engine, bootstrap replay or reviewed database scope is missing. Record a gap rather than substitute old QA.

workingTreeReview.note: Existing scoped R02 edits reviewed and preserved; only factual prerequisite corrections and additive onboarding evidence are authorized.

validationCommands: Node JSON parsing and all candidate raw SQL/seed hash readback; no fake replay claim.
npm run supabase:migration-ledger:check and npm run skills:check; read-only metadata review.
managerTestPath: Read organization MagicpenDigital Pro identity, exact project status and unchanged old target; provide project dashboard link, then review empty schema/prerequisites and concrete target plan before any cloud mutation.
residualRisk: Organization metadata alone does not identify a project or prove connector access. Candidate bootstrap lacks full canonical replay and private writer/cost runtime acceptance; these remain execution gates.
